subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Is live WeChat account-A/account-B QR-login handoff evidence required before merging this gateway lifecycle change, or may the focused gateway regression suite be accepted as the merge proof?
rationale: The contributor has been clear that their environment cannot run the provider session, and no source-only review can establish the externally managed account-list timing that motivates this change.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until someone captures redacted exact-head evidence that logging in account B leaves account A online through the reload handoff.

options.title: Accept the focused gateway proof
options.body: Explicitly waive live provider proof and merge only after the current-head lifecycle tests and required checks are complete.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until someone captures redacted exact-head evidence that logging in account B leaves account A online through the reload handoff.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the gateway channel lifecycle proof threshold, and the PR timeline routes the original review to this account.
